57: // parseBind parses the bind directive. Syntax:
58: //
59: //	bind <addresses...>
60: func parseBind(h Helper) ([]ConfigValue, error) {
61: 	h.Next() // consume directive name
62: 	return []ConfigValue{{Class: "bind", Value: h.RemainingArgs()}}, nil
63: }

65: // parseTLS parses the tls directive. Syntax:
66: //
67: //	tls [<email>|internal]|[<cert_file> <key_file>] {
68: //	    protocols <min> [<max>]
69: //	    ciphers   <cipher_suites...>
70: //	    curves    <curves...>
71: //	    client_auth {
72: //	        mode                   [request|require|verify_if_given|require_and_verify]
73: //	        trust_pool			   <module_name> [...]
74: //	        trusted_leaf_cert      <base64_der>
75: //	        trusted_leaf_cert_file <filename>
76: //	    }
77: //	    alpn                          <values...>
78: //	    load                          <paths...>
79: //	    ca                            <acme_ca_endpoint>
80: //	    ca_root                       <pem_file>
81: //	    key_type                      [ed25519|p256|p384|rsa2048|rsa4096]
82: //	    dns                           <provider_name> [...]
83: //	    propagation_delay             <duration>
84: //	    propagation_timeout           <duration>
85: //	    resolvers                     <dns_servers...>
86: //	    dns_ttl                       <duration>
87: //	    dns_challenge_override_domain <domain>
88: //	    on_demand
89: //	    reuse_private_keys
90: //	    eab                           <key_id> <mac_key>
91: //	    issuer                        <module_name> [...]
92: //	    get_certificate               <module_name> [...]
93: //	    insecure_secrets_log          <log_file>
94: //	}
95: func parseTLS(h Helper) ([]ConfigValue, error) {
96: 	h.Next() // consume directive name
97: 
98: 	cp := new(caddytls.ConnectionPolicy)
99: 	var fileLoader caddytls.FileLoader
100: 	var folderLoader caddytls.FolderLoader
101: 	var certSelector caddytls.CustomCertSelectionPolicy
102: 	var acmeIssuer *caddytls.ACMEIssuer
103: 	var keyType string
104: 	var internalIssuer *caddytls.InternalIssuer
105: 	var issuers []certmagic.Issuer
106: 	var certManagers []certmagic.Manager
107: 	var onDemand bool
108: 	var reusePrivateKeys bool
109: 
110: 	firstLine := h.RemainingArgs()
111: 	switch len(firstLine) {
112: 	case 0:
113: 	case 1:
114: 		if firstLine[0] == "internal" {
115: 			internalIssuer = new(caddytls.InternalIssuer)
116: 		} else if !strings.Contains(firstLine[0], "@") {
117: 			return nil, h.Err("single argument must either be 'internal' or an email address")
118: 		} else {
119: 			acmeIssuer = &caddytls.ACMEIssuer{
120: 				Email: firstLine[0],
121: 			}
122: 		}
123: 
124: 	case 2:
125: 		// file certificate loader
126: 		certFilename := firstLine[0]
127: 		keyFilename := firstLine[1]
128: 
129: 		// tag this certificate so if multiple certs match, specifically
130: 		// this one that the user has provided will be used, see #2588:
131: 		// https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/issues/2588 ... but we
132: 		// must be careful about how we do this; being careless will
133: 		// lead to failed handshakes
134: 		//
135: 		// we need to remember which cert files we've seen, since we
136: 		// must load each cert only once; otherwise, they each get a
137: 		// different tag... since a cert loaded twice has the same
138: 		// bytes, it will overwrite the first one in the cache, and
139: 		// only the last cert (and its tag) will survive, so any conn
140: 		// policy that is looking for any tag other than the last one
141: 		// to be loaded won't find it, and TLS handshakes will fail
142: 		// (see end of issue #3004)
143: 		//
144: 		// tlsCertTags maps certificate filenames to their tag.
145: 		// This is used to remember which tag is used for each
146: 		// certificate files, since we need to avoid loading
147: 		// the same certificate files more than once, overwriting
148: 		// previous tags
149: 		tlsCertTags, ok := h.State["tlsCertTags"].(map[string]string)
150: 		if !ok {
151: 			tlsCertTags = make(map[string]string)
152: 			h.State["tlsCertTags"] = tlsCertTags
153: 		}
154: 
155: 		tag, ok := tlsCertTags[certFilename]
156: 		if !ok {
157: 			// haven't seen this cert file yet, let's give it a tag
158: 			// and add a loader for it
159: 			tag = fmt.Sprintf("cert%d", len(tlsCertTags))
160: 			fileLoader = append(fileLoader, caddytls.CertKeyFilePair{
161: 				Certificate: certFilename,
162: 				Key:         keyFilename,
163: 				Tags:        []string{tag},
164: 			})
165: 			// remember this for next time we see this cert file
166: 			tlsCertTags[certFilename] = tag
167: 		}
168: 		certSelector.AnyTag = append(certSelector.AnyTag, tag)
169: 
170: 	default:
171: 		return nil, h.ArgErr()
172: 	}
173: 
174: 	var hasBlock bool
175: 	for h.NextBlock(0) {
176: 		hasBlock = true
177: 
178: 		switch h.Val() {
179: 		case "protocols":
180: 			args := h.RemainingArgs()
181: 			if len(args) == 0 {
182: 				return nil, h.Errf("protocols requires one or two arguments")
183: 			}
184: 			if len(args) > 0 {
185: 				if _, ok := caddytls.SupportedProtocols[args[0]]; !ok {
186: 					return nil, h.Errf("wrong protocol name or protocol not supported: '%s'", args[0])
187: 				}
188: 				cp.ProtocolMin = args[0]
189: 			}
190: 			if len(args) > 1 {
191: 				if _, ok := caddytls.SupportedProtocols[args[1]]; !ok {
192: 					return nil, h.Errf("wrong protocol name or protocol not supported: '%s'", args[1])
193: 				}
194: 				cp.ProtocolMax = args[1]
195: 			}
196: 
197: 		case "ciphers":
198: 			for h.NextArg() {
199: 				if !caddytls.CipherSuiteNameSupported(h.Val()) {
200: 					return nil, h.Errf("wrong cipher suite name or cipher suite not supported: '%s'", h.Val())
201: 				}
202: 				cp.CipherSuites = append(cp.CipherSuites, h.Val())
203: 			}
204: 
205: 		case "curves":
206: 			for h.NextArg() {
207: 				if _, ok := caddytls.SupportedCurves[h.Val()]; !ok {
208: 					return nil, h.Errf("Wrong curve name or curve not supported: '%s'", h.Val())
209: 				}
210: 				cp.Curves = append(cp.Curves, h.Val())
211: 			}
212: 
213: 		case "client_auth":
214: 			cp.ClientAuthentication = &caddytls.ClientAuthentication{}
215: 			if err := cp.ClientAuthentication.UnmarshalCaddyfile(h.NewFromNextSegment()); err != nil {
216: 				return nil, err
217: 			}
218: 		case "alpn":
219: 			args := h.RemainingArgs()
220: 			if len(args) == 0 {
221: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
222: 			}
223: 			cp.ALPN = args
224: 
225: 		case "load":
226: 			folderLoader = append(folderLoader, h.RemainingArgs()...)
227: 
228: 		case "ca":
229: 			arg := h.RemainingArgs()
230: 			if len(arg) != 1 {
231: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
232: 			}
233: 			if acmeIssuer == nil {
234: 				acmeIssuer = new(caddytls.ACMEIssuer)
235: 			}
